body:
Implemented anchor-matches? (zero-width assertion: Start checks pos==0, End checks pos==string-length, matching real grep's per-line default semantics since read-line already strips each line) + node-supported?/pattern-supported? updated to correctly report Start/End as supported while honestly flagging WordBoundary (a real AnchorKind variant the parser never actually produces -- no \b handling exists) as still unsupported rather than claiming blanket Anchor support. Hit the same single-field-defenum-bind void* gap as grep.prn's own unbox-bool -- added unbox-anchor-kind, same #target escape hatch. Verified against real grep: ^hello, hello$, ^hello$ all byte-identical. Full 10-pattern regression (including the earlier CharClass fix) all match. Router correctly now routes ^-anchored patterns to turbogrep instead of falling back to real grep. All 336 compiler tests pass.

⚓ ☃
title: Anchor (^/$) implemented -- closes another real audit finding
